results.title: Export always uses ALL tab with total failing count

steps.title: Given the IMPROVE VISIBILITY tab is active and a source type filter is applied
When the analysis export is generated (PowerPoint, PDF, or Excel)
Then the Target Sources section in the export is built from the ALL tab with total failing article counts per source

results.notes: Excel sheet 'Sources à cibler' confirmed: sources with badge 'Améliorer la perception' ONLY (topgear.com, autonext.co, caradisiac.com, greencarreports.com) appear in the export despite IMPROVE VISIBILITY tab being active. Multiple source types (Journalism, Other, Review Sites, Press Release, Corporate, Social/UGC) present despite Journalism filter. Failing counts are TOTALS across both verdict types (frandroid.com=14 total: 12 absent + 2 negative). AC-1 CONFIRMED.

results.title: Excel export four stacked tables with full evidence

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with verified sources having failing articles positive articles and failing prompts
When the Excel workbook is generated
Then the Target Sources tab opens with four stacked tables in order: Ranked sources, Failing articles, Positive articles, Failing prompts
And the Ranked sources table carries columns: Rank, Domain, Source type, Badges, Failing articles, Brand absent, Depicted negatively, Positive articles, Citations in qualifying answers, Brief
And the Failing articles table carries: Domain, Source rank, Article title, URL, Verdict, Passage, Citing engines
And the Positive articles table carries: Domain, Source rank, Article title, URL, Passage, Citing engines (no Verdict column)
And the Failing prompts table carries: Domain, Source rank, Question, Engine, Country (no Outcome column)
And the sheet header follows the house style with entity, sheet name, markets, engines, and snapshot date

results.notes:
Excel file 'Toyota_AI_Visibility_Report (13) - Copie.xlsx', sheet 'Sources à cibler' verified:
- R1 header: 'Toyota - Sources à cibler (United States · ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity · snapshot Sep 18, 2026 – Sep 24, 2026)' ✓
- Table 1 'Sources classées' R5 — 10 cols: Rang, Domaine, Type de source, Badges, Articles problématiques, Marque absente, Décrite négativement, Articles positifs, Citations dans les réponses défavorables, Résumé ✓
- Table 2 'Articles problématiques' R86 — 7 cols: Domaine, Rang de la source, Titre de l'article, URL, Verdict, Passage, Moteurs citant ✓ — Passage empty for brand-absent rows ✓
- Table 3 'Articles positifs' R234 — 6 cols: Domaine, Rang de la source, Titre de l'article, URL, Passage, Moteurs citant — no Verdict col ✓
- Table 4 'Prompts problématiques' R376 — 5 cols: Domaine, Rang de la source, Question, Moteur, Pays — no Outcome col ✓
AC-4 CONFIRMED.

results.title: PowerPoint carries brief for top 3 sources only

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with more than 3 verified sources (78 sources)
When the PowerPoint export is generated
Then the top 3 sources each display the full brief sentence on the slide
And sources ranked 4 and beyond show only their failing article count without a brief
And when sources exceed what a slide holds the top sources are shown and full totals are stated following the capping convention

results.notes:
PPTX slide 14 'ACTIONS · SOURCES À CIBLER' verified:
- #1 frandroid.com: full brief 'This source has 14 unfavorable articles: 12 where the brand is entirely absent and 2 where the brand is depicted negatively, and 3 articles that cover the brand positively.' ✓
- #2 kbb.com: full brief 'This source has 9 unfavorable articles: 5 where the brand is entirely absent and 4 where the brand is depicted negatively, and 9 articles that cover the brand positively.' ✓
- #3 zonebourse.com: full brief 'This source has 9 unfavorable articles where the brand is entirely absent, and 6 articles that cover the brand positively.' ✓
- #4 automobile-propre.com: only count '7 · 15×' — no brief ✓
- #5-10: only Type + Action + count — no brief ✓
- Footer: 'Les 10 sources affichées portent 62 des 145 articles problématiques · 78 sources à cibler au total' — total stated ✓
AC-5 CONFIRMED.

results.title: Export Target Sources section uses 7-day source window

When the analysis export is generated
Then the Target Sources section in the export is built from at least 7 days of data regardless of the shorter selected date range

results.skipReason: No sub-7-day date range option exists in staging date picker (minimum = '7 derniers jours'). Cannot configure the Given state (date range < 7 days). Cannot verify the differential behavior (Target Sources = 7-day floor vs AI Citation Sources = selected range) without a sub-7-day filter. Export header shows '7 derniers jours = Sep 18–Sep 24, 2026' which is consistent with the 7-day floor — but this doesn't prove the floor applies independently.
results.notes: Staging date picker options: Dernière analyse, 7 derniers jours, 30 derniers jours, 3 derniers mois, 12 derniers mois, Toutes les analyses. No sub-7-day option. AC-8 requires a 3-day (or shorter) filter to be tested.
